question: Who among the following personalities is associated with the Mohiniattam dance?
solution:
The correct option is __**Jayaprabha Menon.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​Jayaprabha Menon is one of the most accomplished dancers of **Mohiniattam** from Kerala.
 
• Jayaprabha Menon is a disciple of **guru Bharathi Shivaji.**
 
• Mohiniyattam, is an** Indian classical dance form of Kerala.**
 
• Mohiniyattam includes music in the **Carnatic style, singing and acting a play through the dance.**
 
• **Sunanda Nair,Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma, Pallavi Krishnan, Gopika Varma** some famous personalities related to Mohiniattam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy**

 
 
• ​She is related to Bharatnattyam.
 
• She had been awarded by Padma Bhushan Award in 2001 and Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.
 
 
 
• **Prerana Shrimali**
 
 
• She is a senior dancer of Jaipur Gharana of Kathak
 
• Shrimali has been awarded the Rajasthan Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Rashtriya Ekta Award.
 
 
 
• ​ **Vyjayanthi Kash**i
 
 
• Vyjayanthi Kashi is an Indian classical Kuchipudi dancer.
 
• She is the present member of Central Sangeet Natak Akademi.
